text:
Maria (partnerships): heads up — we need to align on the LangChain + LlamaIndex connector compatibility baseline for the SigmaCloud hardware partner joint announcement. timeline? :calendar:
Devon (eng-ml): I can own the compatibility matrix. question: do we commit to runtime fallbacks (quantized variants) in the GA?
Sam (devex): +1. We should also confirm example notebooks and a quickstart for both libs. those are the things customers expect in marketplace listings.
Anya (product): can we scope announcement tiers: marketplace listing (week A), partner co-announcement (week B), SI enablement workshop (week C)? want clear ask for each partner.
Lee (sdks): adapter wise — our gateway adapter needs a small shim for LlamaIndex's storage connector. sketch:
```
# example adapter config
adapter: redwood-gateway
model: redwood-7b-llmq
compat: ["langchain>=0.1.2","llama_index>=0.7.0"]
kv_cache: true
```
I'll open PR with test harness.
Tara (solutions): for SI (NorthStar) enablement, they need a runbook and 1-day lab. I can draft the lab plan but need sample datasets and a perf deck.
Devon (eng-ml): perf note — SigmaCloud's latest A100 ring has jitter on small-batch 1-token ops; recommend we include batching defaults in the adapter and a sample config: `batch.window_ms=8` `max_batch=32`.
Maria (partnerships): ok action items: Devon -> compatibility matrix + perf knobs (due Tue), Lee -> PR + notebooks (due Wed), Sam -> marketplace assets + quickstart copy (due Thu), Tara -> SI lab draft (due Thu). Anya -> coordinate announcement dates with SigmaCloud comms.
Sam (devex): filesystem layout for quickstart: `/examples/langchain`, `/examples/llama_index`, `/notebooks/marketplace_preview.ipynb`. I'll include screenshots and minimal CLI steps.
Lee (sdks): question on telemetry — are we allowed to auto-collect anonymized metrics for marketplace listing? privacy check with security.
Maria (partnerships): we'll only collect opt-in telemetry. Security signoff needed, not default. ping @security.
DeployBot (bot): deployment scheduled: adapter-integration branch -> staging cluster at 2026-05-13T09:00Z.
Anya (product): PR checklist for announcement: integration docs, rollback plan, messaging snippets for both partners, customer-facing FAQ. I'll draft and share by EOD.
Tara (solutions): can someone drop sample PII-free docs for the SI lab? I can anonymize if needed.
Devon (eng-ml): dropping one perf test snippet below for reproducibility:
```
python perf_test.py --model redwood-7b --sequence 512 --batch 1 --iters 200
```
results will go into the compatibility matrix.
Maria (partnerships): love it — small follow-up: timeline contingency if SI wants delay. keep announcement decoupled from GA if needed. :thumbsup:
Sam (devex): noted. I'll keep marketplace listing as "preview" state until SI signoff.
Lee (sdks): will include LangChain and LlamaIndex integration tests in CI. tagging reviewers: @dev-ml, @devex.
Maria (partnerships): thanks everyone — check ins Mon/Wed. I'll update the shared doc with owners. :rocket:
